posts.content: The word "productively" describes the way a person works, uses time or resources to produce good, valuable results, or achieves goals effectively.

posts.title: proDUCTively 2
posts.content: proDUCTively \prơ DƯC tive ly\ /prəˈdʌk.tɪv.li/ •⬤•• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used to describe an action performed effectively, yielding many results or achieving a goal in the best possible way.

posts.title: QUICKly 1
posts.content: The word "QUICKly" is used to describe an action performed in a short amount of time, quickly. It conveys a sense of urgency, speed, and efficiency in completing a task.

posts.title: QUICKly 2
posts.content: QUICKly \QUICK ly\ /ˈkwɪkli/ ⬤• (TWO SYLlables) in English means "quickly" or "hastily." This word is often used to describe an action or process that takes place in a short period of time.

posts.title: RAPidly 1
posts.content: The word "RAPidly" is used to describe an action or process that occurs at a high speed, quickly. It emphasizes speed and changes that take place in a short period of time.

posts.title: RAPidly 2
posts.content: RAPidly \RAP id ly\ /ˈræpɪdli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe a process, change, or development that occurs quickly.

posts.title: INstantly 1
posts.content: The word "instantly" is used to describe an action or event that occurs very quickly, without delay. It conveys the idea of immediacy.

posts.title: INstantly 2
posts.content: INstantly \IN sta̛nt ly\ /ˈɪnstəntli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) in English means "immediately" or "instantly" and is often used to describe an action or event that occurs very quickly, without delay.

posts.title: SUDdenly 1
posts.content: The word "SUDdenly" is used to describe an event or action that happens quickly, without warning, and often comes as a surprise.

posts.title: SUDdenly 2
posts.content: SUDdenly \SƯD de̛n ly\ /ˈsʌdənli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used in English to describe an event or change that occurs unexpectedly, without warning.

posts.title: PAtiently 1
posts.content: The word "Patiently" describes an action or state carried out with patience—without haste, and without becoming easily irritable or annoyed.

posts.title: PAtiently 2
posts.content: PAtiently \PĀ tie̛nt ly\ /ˈpeɪ.ʃənt.li/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe an action or situation that unfolds patiently, without haste or impatience.

posts.title: TIRElessly 1
posts.content: The word "TIRElessly" is used to describe an action performed continuously and without pause, even in the face of difficulties. It conveys the perseverance and strong determination of the person performing the action.

posts.title: TIRElessly 2
posts.content: TIRElessly \TĪRE le̛s sly\ /ˈtaɪrləsli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe an action performed continuously, persistently, and tirelessly.

posts.title: perSISTently 1
posts.content: The word "perSISTently" is used to describe an action carried out with determination, without giving up easily, even in the face of difficulties or obstacles. It reflects a person's resolve and perseverance.

posts.title: perSISTently 2
posts.content: perSISTently \pe̛r SIS te̛nt ly\ /pəˈsɪs.tənt.li/ •⬤•• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used to describe an action or state that is maintained resolutely and relentlessly, despite difficulties or obstacles.

posts.title: STEADily 1
posts.content: The word "STEADily" describes how an action, process, or state occurs continuously, without sudden changes or significant fluctuations, and often indicates stability and certainty.

posts.title: STEADily 2
posts.content: STEADily \STEAD i̛ ly\ /ˈsted.ə.li/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe an action or process that occurs steadily, continuously, and without many sudden changes.

posts.title: CAREfully 1
posts.content: The word "CAREfully" is used to describe an action performed meticulously and thoughtfully, avoiding mistakes or accidents. It conveys a sense of care and caution.

posts.title: CAREfully 2
posts.content: CAREfully \CARE fưl ly\ /ˈkerfəli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) in English means "carefully" or "thoughtfully", and is often used to describe an action performed meticulously to avoid mistakes.

posts.title: meTICulously 1
posts.content: The word "meTICulously" is used to describe an action performed with great care and precision, paying attention to even the smallest details. It conveys accuracy, thoroughness, and a commitment to high quality.

posts.title: meTICulously 2
posts.content: meTICulously \me̛ TIC u lơus ly\ /məˈtɪkjələsli/ •⬤••• (FIVE SYLlables) in English means "meticulously" or "with great attention to detail". This word is often used to describe an action performed with great care and precision.

posts.title: CAUtiously 1
posts.content: The word "CAUtiously" describes how an action is carried out or a situation is approached with caution, paying attention to potential dangers or problems. It conveys a sense of vigilance and careful consideration before acting.

posts.title: CAUtiously 2
posts.content: CAUtiously \CAU tiơus ly\ /ˈkɔː.ʃəs.li/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe an action performed with care, caution, and attention to potential dangers or problems.

posts.title: atTENtively 1
posts.content: The word "atTENtively" describes an action or state carried out carefully, attentively, and with a focus on detail.

posts.title: atTENtively 2
posts.content: atTENtively \a̛t TEN tive ly\ /əˈten.tɪv.li/ •⬤•• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used to describe an action performed attentively, intently, and with focus, paying close attention to every detail.

posts.title: SLOWly 1
posts.content: The word "SLOWly" is used to describe an action performed at a slow, unhurried pace. It can convey slowness, deliberateness, or delay.

posts.title: SLOWly 2
posts.content: SLOWly \SLŌW ly\ /ˈsləʊli/ ⬤• (TWO SYLlables) in English means "slowly" and is often used to describe the speed of an action, process, or change.

posts.title: LAzily 1
posts.content: The word "LAzily" is used to describe an action performed slowly, halfheartedly, or without effort. It conveys a lack of motivation and laziness in completing a task.

posts.title: LAzily 2
posts.content: LAzily \LĀ zi̛ ly\ /ˈleɪzəli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables)is an adverb used to describe an action performed slowly, listlessly, and without effort.

posts.title: GRADually 1
posts.content: The word "GRADually" is used to describe a process that takes place gradually, slowly, step by step, and not suddenly.

posts.title: GRADually 2
posts.content: GRADually \GRAD ü a̛l ly\ /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ ⬤••• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used in English to describe a process that occurs slowly, step by step, without any sudden changes.

posts.title: beLAtedly 1
posts.content: The word "beLAtedly" describes an action or event that occurs later than expected or anticipated. It often evokes a sense of regret or the realization that something was recognized too late.

posts.title: beLAtedly 2
posts.content: beLAtedly \be LĀ ted ly\ /bɪˈleɪ.tɪd.li/ •⬤•• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used to describe an action or event that occurs later than expected or anticipated.

posts.title: HAPpily 1
posts.content: The word "HAPpily" is used to describe an action, state, or situation characterized by joy, satisfaction, and contentment. It expresses positive human emotions.

posts.title: HAPpily 2
posts.content: HAPpily \HAP pi̛ ly\ /ˈhæpəli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is commonly used to express a state of joy, happiness, or contentment.

posts.title: POSitively 1
posts.content: The word "POSitively" can have several meanings depending on the context: In a positive sense: Expressing optimism, hope, or a focus on the good. In an affirmative, decisive sense: Expressing certainty, without doubt. In a beneficial sense: Leading to good results.

posts.title: POSitively 2
posts.content: POSitively \POS i̛ tive ly\ /ˈpɒz.ə.tɪv.li/ ⬤••• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used to describe a positive, favorable action, thought, or outcome.

posts.title: JOYfully 1
posts.content: The word "JOYfully" is used to describe an action performed with joy, pleasure, and excitement. It conveys a positive and cheerful emotional state.

posts.title: JOYfully 2
posts.content: JOYfully \JOY fưl ly\ /ˈdʒɔɪfəli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe an action, emotion, or state that is performed or experienced with joy and happiness.

posts.title: CHEERfully 1
posts.content: The word "CHEERfully" is used to describe an action or attitude carried out in a cheerful, optimistic manner, expressing satisfaction or enthusiasm.

posts.title: CHEERfully 2
posts.content: CHEERfully \CHEER fưl ly\ /ˈtʃɪrfəli/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is an adverb used to describe an action performed in a cheerful, enthusiastic, and positive manner.

posts.title: GENTly 1
posts.content: The word "GENTly" is used to describe an action performed gently, without force, and without causing harm. It can apply to a variety of situations, from handling a fragile object to speaking to someone gently.

posts.title: GENTly 2
posts.content: GENTly \GENT ly\ /ˈdʒɛntlɪ/ ⬤• (TWO SYLlables) is often used to describe an action performed gently, softly, without causing harm or discomfort.

posts.title: DELicately 1
posts.content: The word "DELicately" is often used to describe an action performed carefully and gently, taking care not to cause harm or inconvenience to others or other objects. It can also imply subtlety in the way an issue is expressed or handled.

posts.title: DELicately 2
posts.content: DELicately \DEL i̛ ca̛te ly\ /ˈdɛlɪkətli/ ⬤••• (FOUR SYLlables) is often used to describe an action performed skillfully or gently, or a situation that requires tact and sensitivity.

posts.title: SOFTly 1
posts.content: The word "SOFTly" is used to describe an action performed gently, without force, and often conveys a sense of gentleness and comfort. It can also be used to describe a soft, quiet sound.

posts.title: SOFTly 2
posts.content: SOFTly \SOFT ly\ /ˈsɒftli/ ⬤• (TWO SYLlables) is an adverb commonly used to describe an action performed gently, softly, and not forcefully.

posts.title: TENderly 1
posts.content: The word "TENderly" describes an action or statement made in a gentle, affectionate manner that expresses care, love, and compassion.

posts.title: TENderly 2
posts.content: TENderly \TEN de̛r ly\ /ˈten.dər.li/ ⬤•• (THREE SYLlables) is often used to describe an action or statement made in a gentle, affectionate manner that expresses care and love.

posts.title: BEAUtiful
posts.content: BEAUtiful] (ADjective): Đẹp, có những phẩm chất đem lại sự hài lòng hoặc thỏa mãn cho các giác quan (đặc biệt là thị giác) hoặc cho tâm trí. Thường ám chỉ sự hài hòa, xuất sắc hoặc có tính thẩm mỹ cao.

posts.title: atTRACtive
posts.content: atTRACtive] (ADjective): Hấp dẫn, lôi cuốn, có sức hút. Từ này dùng để mô tả người hoặc vật có những đặc điểm làm hài lòng thị giác hoặc thu hút sự chú ý, quan tâm của người khác.

posts.title: because
posts.content: Because (liên cơ): Bởi vì. Từ này được dùng để mở đầu cho một câu con chỉ nguyên nhân, lý do giải thích cho một sự việc hoặc hành động trước đó.

posts.title: GRATEful
posts.content: GRATEful] (ADjective): Biết ơn, cảm kích. Từ này thể hiện lòng biết ơn hoặc sự trân trọng đối với những gì người khác đã làm cho mình hoặc những điều tốt đẹp mà mình nhận được.

posts.title: although
posts.content: Although (liên cơ): Mặc dù, dẫu cho. Từ này được dùng để mở đầu cho một câu con chỉ sự nhượng bộ, thể hiện một kết quả bất ngờ hoặc tương phản với thực tế được nhắc đến trong câu con đó.

posts.title: if
posts.content: If (liên cơ): Nếu, nếu như, giả sử. Từ này được dùng để mở đầu cho một câu con điều kiện, diễn tả một tình huống giả định, một khả năng có thể xảy ra hoặc một điều kiện cần thiết để một sự việc khác diễn ra. Ngoài ra, trong câu gián tiếp, nó còn mang nghĩa là "liệu có... hay không".

posts.title: when
posts.content: When (liên cơ / Trạng Cơ / đại cơ quan hệ): Khi, vào lúc, khi nào. Khi làm liên cơ: Dùng để kết nối hai câu con, chỉ thời điểm một sự việc xảy ra hoặc một hành động được thực hiện. Khi làm trạng cơ: Dùng trong câu hỏi để hỏi về thời gian. Khi làm đại cơ quan hệ: Dùng để bổ nghĩa cho một Danh Cơ chỉ thời gian đứng trước nó.

posts.title: CLEAR
posts.content: [CLEAR] is a [ROOT VERB] that means to remove things that are not wanted from a place, or to make something easy to see or understand. [CLEAR] là một [ROOT VERB][GỐC ĐỘNG] có nghĩa là dọn dẹp, xóa bỏ những thứ không mong muốn khỏi một nơi nào đó, hoặc làm cho cái gì đó trở nên dễ nhìn, dễ hiểu (rõ ràng).

posts.title: reSPOND
posts.content: reSPOND] is a [Root Verb Base] that means to say or write something as an answer, or to react to something. [reSPOND] là một [Rễ Động Cơ \Root Verb Base] có nghĩa là phản hồi, trả lời, hoặc phản ứng lại một tác động trước đó.

posts.title: creATE
posts.content: creATE] is a [Root Verb Base] that means to bring something into existence, or to cause something to happen. [creATE] là một [Rễ Động Cơ \Root Verb Base] có nghĩa là tạo ra, sáng tạo, hoặc làm cho một điều gì đó xuất hiện.
